newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Metals - China Steel may hike prices.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Metals - China Steel may hike prices.

text.p: Taiwan's steel product prices may rise by two to three percent as the island's largest producer, China Steel Corp, is expected to adjust its prices on Thursday, local metals traders said on Tuesday.
"China Steel will announce its fourth quarter hot and cold rolled steel prices on August 21 with a rise of two to three percent," a Taipei-based metals trader said.
China Steel officials declined to comment.
China Steel's third quarter hot and cold rolled steel prices were fixed at T$10.75 and T$13.85 per kg, respectively.
Metal traders said galvanised and other local steel makers are likely to hike their prices if China Steel adjusted its fourth quarter prices higher.
"Most of the steel products' makers will follow China Steel's price adjustments," a steel buyer said.
